source.title: Workshop safety planning
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The workshop supervisor will carry out an inspection before a new machine is used. The team must comply with the safety rules, even when several orders are waiting. A short training session will show staff where to stop the machine and whom to contact if something goes wrong. The supervisor will ask a colleague to check that the written instructions match the controls on the machine.
